name: Meguri Waste
description: Meguri Waste is a calm WordPress landing theme for a scheduled commercial waste collection service. A pannable watercolour dock panorama with hanging day tags opens one long page of ruled stream rows, a flat pictogram line for a collection day and weekly cover price rows, with a single repeated call to action.
